title: Tutorial Slides
description: Semantic source of truth for the title-menu tutorial slides. Fixed 4-row geometry (rows 5-8 plus the [LR] NAV [B] EXIT footer at row 16); the compiler pads short slides with blank lines.

slides.description: Slides in navigation order. At least one (the title menu links here unconditionally).

items.description: One slide line. Max 19 chars + NUL (fixed [20] ROM arrays); the box renders 18 wide, so longer than 18 warns.
